Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Community & Comms Manager role at The Fix. Your focus on strategic product communications for NewsTech, especially the newsletter, webinars, and onboarding/retention messaging, is exactly the kind of work I want to do.

In my current roles, I manage content calendars across multiple client websites, write SEO-driven content, and use analytics to refine messaging. I've built and maintained WordPress sites, including a pharmacists' association with ~600 member profiles, which taught me how to keep a large community engaged with consistent, clear communication. I also use AI tools daily to streamline research and content production, and I'm comfortable coordinating with designers and stakeholders.

I have a genuine interest in MediaTech and the media sector, and I'm fluent in English. I'd love to bring my content and community skills to The Fix.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Community & Comms Manager position at The Fix. The opportunity to own strategic product communications for NewsTech, from the dedicated newsletter to webinars and onboarding/retention messaging, aligns perfectly with my experience in content production, community management, and data-informed communication.

In my freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've built and maintained websites for diverse clients, including a pharmacists' association with approximately 600 member profile pages. This required a consistent content calendar, close coordination with stakeholders, and a clear understanding of how to keep a community informed and engaged. I've also produced SEO-driven blog content, managed CMS platforms like WordPress and Shopify, and used analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console to measure and improve engagement. My daily use of AI tools for research and content creation helps me work efficiently and creatively.

While my background is in digital marketing and web development, I've always been drawn to media and technology. I follow the evolving MediaTech landscape and understand the challenges independent newsrooms face in reaching and retaining audiences. I'm fluent in English and comfortable working with cross-functional teams, including designers and vendor management, to ensure messaging is cohesive and impactful.

I'm eager to bring my skills in content strategy, community engagement, and technical communication to The Fix. I'm confident that my ability to manage multiple stakeholders and produce compelling content across channels will help grow the NewsTech platform and support its users.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Managed content calendars and CMS for multiple client websites, including a pharmacists' association with ~600 member profiles, ensuring consistent communication and engagement.
• Produced SEO-driven blog content and social media posts, using analytics (Google Analytics, Search Console) to refine messaging and drive user engagement.
• Built and optimized WordPress sites with structured data and accessible markup, demonstrating technical fluency and attention to user experience.
• Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research and content creation, streamlining production and bringing creative ideas to every channel.
• Fluent in English; native Turkish; experience coordinating with designers and stakeholders to deliver cohesive messaging across platforms.
